title: Alike
description: An extended critical reading of Alike (2015): color and animation, urban routine, parenting, music, schooling, creative attention, and reception.
image_alt: Film still from Alike: Paste reacting with curiosity in the pale, conformist city
abstract: Through a close reading of animated performance, color, repeated spaces, musical interruption, and parent-child attention, this expanded analysis interprets Alike (2015) in conversation with filmmakers’ accounts, education and motivation research, and clearly attributed tertiary commentary.
citation_title: Alike: Color, Conformity, and the Practice of Attention
citation_apa_title: Alike: Color, conformity, and the practice of attention
